status: freeze collection before model outcomes; development only
boundaries: Complete AST function_item nodes with body; no nested function whose ancestor is a function; reject functions with parser errors. Preserve exact byte offsets and source hash.
eligibility: Source paths under inventory-owned M00/M04/M10 packages; exclude /tests/ and /tests.rs as original path policy; function text >=80 bytes. Keep direct inline tests tagged, not silently removed.
novelty: Exclude exact AST token-sequence duplicates of baseline source; exclude candidates whose 5-token shingle Jaccard similarity >=0.85 or containment >=0.90 with length ratio >=0.50 versus baseline. No labels or model outcomes influence novelty decisions.
families: Union same source path across branches; union paths after removing _vN/-vN version suffixes; union shared qualified package+impl/module+function identity; union exact-token duplicates and candidate near duplicates by same similarity rule. Never split connected components.
labels: Inventory package owner, checked against exact source head and package Cargo manifest; reject any exact function identity with conflicting module labels. These are declared static ownership labels, not independently accepted change destinations.
split: Deterministic SHA256(component sorted token IDs), modulo 5: 0 -> dev_probe, otherwise dev_fit. No retry, balancing search or outcome-based reassignment. Fail closed if either split lacks a class or fewer than 5 independent components overall.
training: None in collection step. No old calibration/evaluation/consumer task data loaded. Any later fit/control comparison requires separate frozen plan.
claims: Historical development corpus only; no future window, independent production acceptance, reward or deployment. Grouping and token thresholds are conservative operational definitions, not proof of statistical independence.
